scripts.text: The peace of this world cannot last forever... The hands of Evil are reaching into the world again...
scripts.translation: 世界的和平無法永遠持續...邪惡之手再次伸向這個世界...

scripts.text: What brought you to this place?

scripts.translation: 關於附有魔力的巴風特娃娃

scripts.text: Huh... Don't you know? This is St. Capitolina Monastery where the Brothers who wish to become monks train and pray.
scripts.translation: 咦...你不知道嗎？這裡是聖卡皮托利納修道院，有志成為修士的兄弟們在此訓練和祈禱。

scripts.text: And this place is... What can I say... Yes. It's the grave of the Devil. Grave...
scripts.translation: 至於這裡...該怎麼說呢...沒錯，這是惡魔的墓穴。墓穴...

scripts.text: The very place where the great Devil who once demolished this world is sleeping.
scripts.translation: 曾經毀滅世界的強大惡魔就沉睡在這裡。

scripts.text: Baphomet... is the name of the Devil... I think you have heard of his name.
scripts.translation: 巴風特...那惡魔的名字...我想你聽過。

scripts.text: Numerous brave men and brothers have trained in this monastery...
scripts.translation: 無數勇敢的人們和修士曾在這座修道院訓練...

scripts.text: Under this gravestone in front of you... Baphomet is sealed.
scripts.translation: 巴風特就被封印在你面前的墓碑之下...

scripts.text: But... As we speak Satan Morocc is marshalling his powerful magic in order to affect all life on this continent.
scripts.translation: 然而...如今魔王夢羅克正在匯聚強大的魔力，企圖影響這片大陸上的所有生命。

scripts.text: Baphomet also... has awakened and is preparing for his revival, into this world, by weakening the power of the seal through the power of Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: 巴風特也...已經甦醒，正藉助魔王夢羅克的力量削弱封印，準備重返這個世界...

scripts.text: Now... I'm looking for someone brave enough to reseal Baphomet in its shrine... as we once did many years ago...
scripts.translation: 如今...我正在尋找足夠勇敢的人，再次將巴風特封印在神殿裡...就像多年前我們所做的那樣...

scripts.text: Anyone who fights for good will know, deep inside, that evil is threatening to conquer this world...
scripts.translation: 任何為正義而戰的人，內心深處都能感受到邪惡正威脅著要征服世界...

scripts.text: Train more and use your skills to protect the world from evil's looming presence...
scripts.translation: 繼續磨練自己，運用你的技能保護世界，抵禦迫近的邪惡...

scripts.text: Anyone who fights for good will know, deep inside, that evil is threatening to conquer this world...
scripts.translation: 任何為正義而戰的人，內心深處都能感受到邪惡正威脅著要征服世界...

scripts.text: Train more and use your skills to protect the world from evil's looming presence...
scripts.translation: 繼續磨練自己，運用你的技能保護世界，抵禦迫近的邪惡...

scripts.text: Do you mean you'll go to the shrine and reseal Baphomet?
scripts.translation: 你是說你願意去神殿重新封印巴風特嗎？

scripts.text: Umm... But it seems that there is a problem here... I'll check quickly. Please wait.
scripts.translation: 嗯...不過這裡似乎出了點問題...我馬上檢查，請稍等。

scripts.text: Okay... I'll adjust the shrine's seal so that you and your group can enter.
scripts.translation: 好...我會調整神殿的封印，讓你和隊伍成員能夠進入。

scripts.text: You will see a sign when the seal has broken. Please wait until the sign appears...
scripts.translation: 封印解除時會出現提示。請等提示出現...

scripts.text: When you see the sign, put your hands on the gravestone... Then you can move inside.
scripts.translation: 看到提示後，把手放在墓碑上...你們就能進入裡面。

scripts.text: One thing that you should remember is... Anyone who enters this shrine will be cursed by Baphomet and cannot enter or leave while they are cursed.
scripts.translation: 有一點要記住...進入神殿的人都會受到巴風特的詛咒，詛咒持續期間無法進出。

scripts.text: And one more thing... In this cursed area, some skills, which are protected by outer physical power are prohibited by the effect of the seal.
scripts.translation: 還有一件事...在這片受詛咒的區域，封印會禁止一些受到外部力量保護的技能。

scripts.text: For example, the skills like ^0000FFSafety Wall and Assumptio^000000... So you'd better prepare before entering the shrine.
scripts.translation: 例如^0000FF光之障壁和聖母之祈福^000000...所以進入神殿前最好做好準備。

scripts.text: Umm... I recognize your courage, but... I can't permit anyone to enter this place. I can only permit the leader of a party to enter first.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我敬佩你的勇氣，但是...我不能允許任何人隨意進入。只能先讓隊長進入。

scripts.text: Once the party leader is permitted, the rest of the party can enter. This is a rule of this monastery, so please understand.
scripts.translation: 隊長獲准進入後，其他隊員才能進入。這是修道院的規定，請理解。

scripts.text: It seems you have entered this shrine recently... You cannot reenter because Baphomet's Curse still remains. Baphomet's Curse disappears only after a certain amount of time has passed.
scripts.translation: 你似乎剛進入過神殿...由於巴風特的詛咒仍在，你暫時無法再次進入。經過一段時間後詛咒才會消失。

scripts.text: Umm... It seems that Baphomet's Curse has weakened. I can remove it now.
scripts.translation: 嗯...看來巴風特的詛咒減弱了。我現在可以幫你解除。
哈啊啊啊...胡克斯波克斯、溫加迪姆、阿布拉卡達布拉!!!!!

scripts.text: Huu... It's over. Now that I've released Baphomet's Curse, you can enter again.
scripts.translation: 呼...完成了。巴風特的詛咒已經解除，你可以再次進入。

scripts.text: Umm... You should train more to enter this dangerous place... You should reach at least Lv 75 to enter here.
scripts.translation: 嗯...這裡很危險，你應該再多訓練一陣子...至少達到75級才能進入。

scripts.text: Please train more and come again.
That is... the villainous doll that you are holding... Let me see it.
scripts.translation: 那是...你拿著的邪惡人偶...讓我看看。

scripts.text: That's correct... I can feel Baphomet's evil inside... So, what will you do with the doll?
scripts.translation: 沒錯...我能感受到裡面巴風特的邪惡...那麼，你打算怎麼處理人偶？

scripts.text: It is just a dangerous and useless thing if you do nothing with it... I'll introduce someone who can help you... Do you want to see him?
scripts.translation: 如果不做處理，它只是危險又沒用的東西...我可以介紹一個人幫你...想見見他嗎？

scripts.text: Go to see ^0000FFRust Blackhand^000000 who is near the main building of the monastery... He will make this doll helpful to you.
scripts.translation: 去找修道院主建築附近的^0000FF拉斯特·黑手^000000...他能讓這個人偶派上用場。

scripts.text: Anyone who fights for good will know, deep inside, that evil is threatening to conquer this world...
scripts.translation: 任何為正義而戰的人，內心深處都能感受到邪惡正威脅著要征服世界...

scripts.text: Train more and use your skills to protect the world from evil's looming presence...
scripts.translation: 繼續磨練自己，運用你的技能保護世界，抵禦迫近的邪惡...

scripts.text: This gravestone has a carving of a wicked devil with large horns. It arouses an ominous feeling.
scripts.translation: 墓碑上刻著長有巨角的邪惡惡魔，透著一股不祥的氣息。

scripts.text: It's cold to the touch. It doesn't respond.
scripts.translation: 觸手冰冷，沒有任何反應。

scripts.text: To enter this dangerous place, you can't go alone. Come again after you join a party.
scripts.translation: 這麼危險的地方不能獨自進入。加入隊伍後再來吧。

scripts.text: It seems you have entered this shrine recently... You cannot reenter because the curse of Baphomet still remains.
scripts.translation: 你似乎最近進入過神殿...巴風特的詛咒仍然存在，暫時無法再次進入。

scripts.text: The curse of Baphomet disappears after a certain amount of time after you entered.
scripts.translation: 進入一段時間後，巴風特的詛咒就會消失。

scripts.text: Umm... It seems the curse of Baphomet weakened. I'll clear the bad curse.
scripts.translation: 嗯...巴風特的詛咒似乎減弱了。我來替你解除。
哈啊啊啊...溫加迪姆·萊維奧薩，呼神護衛!!!!!

scripts.text: Huu... It's over. Now I released all of the curses on you. You can enter again.
scripts.translation: 呼...完成了。你身上的詛咒都解除了，可以再次進入。

scripts.text: Who are you? What do you want me for?
You're not a monk, then what do you want?
scripts.translation: 你不是修士，那找我做什麼？

scripts.text: Did you bring all of the ingredients?
kkk... You prepared the ingredients well. Why don't you leave it there and wait?
scripts.translation: 呵呵...材料準備得不錯。放在那裡等著吧。

scripts.text: Hmm... It's been such a long time since I last saw these wicked horns... kkk... Let me start...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我好久沒見到這對邪惡的角了...呵呵...開始吧...

scripts.text: It's done. You may be excited, of course. I understand...
scripts.translation: 完成了。你肯定很興奮，我能理解...

scripts.text: I don't accept complaints or A/S requests, so use it with care. I must go...
scripts.translation: 我不接受投訴或售後要求，用的時候小心點。我得走了...

scripts.text: Huu... You don't understand what I said. You cannot make anything with these ingredients.
scripts.translation: 唉...你沒聽懂我的話。材料不齊，什麼也做不了。

scripts.text: I'll tell you the ingredients one more time, so please gather them correctly.
scripts.translation: 我再說一遍所需材料，請正確收集。

scripts.text: ^0000FFCursed Baphomet Doll, Magestic Goat, 30 Crystal of Darkness, 50 Fragment of Darkness^000000, and the most important, production cost is ^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: ^0000FF詛咒巴風特人偶、魔力山羊、30個黑暗結晶、50個黑暗碎片^000000，最重要的是還要支付^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny製作費。
關於附有魔力的巴風特娃娃

scripts.text: What?... Hmmm... Did you get the doll? You're pretty good, unlike your appearance...
scripts.translation: 什麼？...嗯...你拿到人偶了？看來你不像外表那樣不中用...

scripts.text: Let me see... Needless to say, Patric must have sent you here to deal with the doll, right?
scripts.translation: 讓我看看...不用說，一定是帕特里克叫你來處理人偶的吧？

scripts.text: Cool... I'll help you make the evil doll useful. What? What can I do?
scripts.translation: 不錯...我來幫你讓邪惡人偶發揮作用。你問我能做什麼？

scripts.text: I can make the strong and large horns of the wicked devil Baphomet for you. A helm that has his immense power.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你製作邪惡魔王巴風特那對強大巨角的頭飾，讓它蘊含他的巨大力量。

scripts.text: It is called the ^4d4dffGigantic Magestic Goat^000000. You'll realize that the Magestic Goat you're familiar with is nothing in comparison.
scripts.translation: 它叫作^4d4dff巨大魔力山羊^000000。和它相比，你熟悉的魔力山羊根本不值一提。

scripts.text: The Cursed Baphomet Doll is the most important ingredient... I'll make you if you want. What would you like to do?
scripts.translation: 詛咒巴風特人偶是最重要的材料...只要你願意，我就能幫你製作。你想怎麼做？

scripts.text: kkk... Yes, wise men take their chances when the opportunity comes. I'll tell you the ingredients. Don't forget, and bring them all.
scripts.translation: 呵呵...聰明人會把握機會。我告訴你所需材料，記住一樣都別漏。

scripts.text: ^0000FFCursed Baphomet Doll, Magestic Goat, 30 Crystal of Darkness, 50 Fragment of Darkness^000000, and the most important, production cost is ^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: ^0000FF詛咒巴風特人偶、魔力山羊、30個黑暗結晶、50個黑暗碎片^000000，最重要的是還要支付^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny製作費。

scripts.text: You can get the Magestic Goat from the weak Baphomet in the Labyrinth Forest. Crystal of Darkness and Fragment of Darkness are from the Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 魔力山羊可以從迷宮森林裡的弱化巴風特身上取得。黑暗結晶和黑暗碎片則由夢羅克化身掉落。

scripts.text: I'm sure that you can get the ingredients because you sealed the real Baphomet. Can't you? kkk...
scripts.translation: 你既然封印過真正的巴風特，肯定能弄到這些材料吧？呵呵...

scripts.text: You'll never know how great this hat is until you get one. If you understood, go and get the ingredients.
scripts.translation: 拿到這頂頭飾之前，你不會知道它有多棒。明白的話就去收集材料吧。

scripts.text: Huh... Do you? Do whatever you want... Do you really want to let this opportunity go to waste?
scripts.translation: 哼...是嗎？隨你便...你真要白白錯過這個機會？

scripts.text: Tut, tut... I don't care if the wicked doll threatens your life all the time!
scripts.translation: 嘖嘖...邪惡人偶一直威脅你的性命，我可不管！

scripts.text: What a dull boy he is... huh...
If you don't have business with me, go away! As you see, I make equipment for the Brothers at the monastery, not for adventurers like you. Do you understand?
scripts.translation: 沒事就走開！如你所見，我是給修道院的兄弟們製作裝備，不是給你這種冒險者做的。明白嗎？
關於附有魔力的巴風特娃娃

scripts.text: What?... You again? What do you want this time?
scripts.translation: 什麼？...又是你？這次想要什麼？

scripts.text: What? You got another doll from the wicked devil? Umm... You're much better than I thought...
scripts.translation: 什麼？你又拿到了邪惡魔王的人偶？嗯...你比我想像中厲害多了...

scripts.text: If you want to make the doll into a ^4d4dffGigantic Magestic Goat^000000 again, I can make you another.
scripts.translation: 如果你還想把人偶做成^4d4dff巨大魔力山羊^000000，我可以再幫你做一頂。

scripts.text: I'll tell you the ingredients again. So, do you want to make?
scripts.translation: 我再說一遍材料。你要製作嗎？

scripts.text: kkk... Yes, wise men take their chances when the opportunity comes. I'll tell you the ingredients. Don't forget, and bring them all.
scripts.translation: 呵呵...聰明人會把握機會。我告訴你所需材料，記住一樣都別漏。

scripts.text: ^0000FFCursed Baphomet Doll, Magestic Goat, 30 Crystal of Darkness, 50 Fragment of Darkness^000000, and the most important, production cost is ^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: ^0000FF詛咒巴風特人偶、魔力山羊、30個黑暗結晶、50個黑暗碎片^000000，最重要的是還要支付^0000FF990000^000000 Zeny製作費。

scripts.text: You can get the Magestic Goat from the weak Baphomet in the Labyrinth Forest. Crystal of Darkness and Fragment of Darkness are from the Incarnation of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 魔力山羊可以從迷宮森林裡的弱化巴風特身上取得。黑暗結晶和黑暗碎片則由夢羅克化身掉落。

scripts.text: I'm sure that you can get the ingredients because you sealed the real Baphomet. Can't you? kkk...
scripts.translation: 你既然封印過真正的巴風特，肯定能弄到這些材料吧？呵呵...

scripts.text: You'll never know how great this hat is until you get one. If you understood, go and get the ingredients.
scripts.translation: 拿到這頂頭飾之前，你不會知道它有多棒。明白的話就去收集材料吧。

scripts.text: Huh... Do you? Do whatever you want... Do you really want to let this opportunity go to waste?
scripts.translation: 哼...是嗎？隨你便...你真要白白錯過這個機會？

scripts.text: Tut, tut... I don't care if the wicked doll threatens your life all the time!
scripts.translation: 嘖嘖...邪惡人偶一直威脅你的性命，我可不管！

scripts.text: What a dull boy he is... huh...
Why are you hanging around here? If you don't want a ^4d4dffGigantic Magestic Goat^000000, go away.
scripts.translation: 你在這裡磨蹭什麼？不想要^4d4dff巨大魔力山羊^000000就走開。

scripts.text: When touching the gravestone, I hear a voice.
scripts.translation: 觸碰墓碑時，你聽到了一個聲音。

scripts.text: I have waited and waited for a brave adventurer like you who will come back here again...
scripts.translation: 我一直在等待像你這樣會再次歸來的勇敢冒險者...

scripts.text: I was one of the warriors to stop Baphomet like you. Now, I'm dead and only my soul remains...
scripts.translation: 我曾和你一樣，是討伐巴風特的戰士之一。如今我已死去，只剩下靈魂...

scripts.text: As you know... We don't have much time. You can't stop Baphomet by yourselves. The power of the devil has strengthened over the years.
scripts.translation: 你也知道...我們時間不多了。憑你們自己無法阻止巴風特。惡魔的力量這些年來不斷增強。

scripts.text: In the past, my companions and I sealed Baphomet at the altar located on the 2nd basement and blocked the entrance.
scripts.translation: 過去，我和同伴在地下二樓的祭壇封印了巴風特，並封鎖了入口。

scripts.text: I moved my soul's essence to my pendant, so that I could remain in this world. That's when I became this grave's guardian.
scripts.translation: 為了留在這個世界，我把靈魂精華轉移到吊墜裡。從那時起，我便成了這座墓穴的守護者。

scripts.text: Baphomet's power is about to break the seal that we made. If you don't reactivate them... Baphomet's revival will only be a matter of time.
scripts.translation: 巴風特即將突破我們設下的封印。如果不重新啟用它們...巴風特復活只是時間問題。

scripts.text: To open the entrance, you must substantialize my soul. I'll open the entrance and reactivate the weakened seals after I am substantilized.
scripts.translation: 想開啟入口，必須先讓我的靈魂實體化。實體化之後，我會開啟入口並重新啟用已減弱的封印。

scripts.text: To substantialize my soul, you should find my pendant. You can find my body near a grave here.
scripts.translation: 要讓我的靈魂實體化，你得找到我的吊墜。我的遺體就在附近一座墓碑旁。

scripts.text: If your ^0000FFparty leader^000000 brings me the pendant, my soul can be substantialized. So, hurry up.
scripts.translation: 只要你們的^0000FF隊長^000000把吊墜帶來，我的靈魂就能實體化。快去吧。

scripts.text: I can feel the voice becoming faint.
To open the entrance, you must substantialize my soul. I'll open the entrance and reactivate the weakened seals after I am substantilized.
scripts.translation: 想開啟入口，必須先讓我的靈魂實體化。實體化之後，我會開啟入口並重新啟用已減弱的封印。

scripts.text: To substantialize my soul, you should find my pendant. You can find my body near a grave here.
scripts.translation: 要讓我的靈魂實體化，你得找到我的吊墜。我的遺體就在附近一座墓碑旁。

scripts.text: If your ^0000FFparty leader^000000 brings me the pendant, my soul can be substantialized. So, hurry up.
scripts.translation: 只要你們的^0000FF隊長^000000把吊墜帶來，我的靈魂就能實體化。快去吧。

scripts.text: Now I can substantialize my soul. I'll wait for you in front of the altar of fire located at the center of this grave. Let's meet there.
scripts.translation: 現在我可以實體化了。我會在墓穴中央的火焰祭壇前等你。我們在那裡會合。

scripts.text: I can feel the voice becoming faint.
Are you still there? Bring back my pendant as soon as possible.
scripts.translation: 你還在嗎？請儘快把我的吊墜帶回來。

scripts.text: You can find my body near a grave here. Go and get my pendant there.
scripts.translation: 我的遺體就在附近一座墓碑旁。去那裡取回吊墜吧。

scripts.text: I want to talk to ^0000FFa representative among your party^000000. Everyone else, wait here.
scripts.translation: 我要和你們隊伍中的^0000FF一位代表^000000談談。其他人請在這裡等候。

scripts.text: I can feel something odd at the grave. It's like someone is calling out silently...
scripts.translation: 墳墓透著異樣，彷彿有人在無聲地呼喚...

scripts.text: With your help, my soul can be substantialized. I want to talk more, but we do not have enough time...
scripts.translation: 多虧你們，我的靈魂得以實體化。我還想多說些，但我們沒時間了...

scripts.text: I must be substantialized within the next hour. To reach the Main Altar underground, you must help me perform the ceremony for opening each seal.
scripts.translation: 我的實體化只能維持一小時。要前往地下主祭壇，你們必須協助我舉行儀式，逐一開啟封印。

scripts.text: Now I'll tell you what should you do. First, collect ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 from the torches on the graves...
scripts.translation: 接下來告訴你們該做什麼。首先，從墓地的火炬上收集^0000FF火焰精華^000000...

scripts.text: Second, all members who will enter the underground must carry a symbol, called the Token of Apostle.
scripts.translation: 其次，所有進入地下區域的成員都必須攜帶一種名為使徒之證的信物。
什麼是雷神托爾的精魄

scripts.text: What is a Token of Apostle?
You can see the torches here and there. These torches are the essence of Thor, the god of Thunder. They are inherited from our predecessors to stop the darkness of Baphomet...
scripts.translation: 你們可以看到四處的火炬。這些火炬蘊含雷神索爾的精華，是先輩們留下來抵禦巴風特黑暗力量的...

scripts.text: To open the sealed underground gate, I must be purified by the ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 which has the power of Thor. Collect ^0000FF10 Essence of Fire^000000 from the torches.
scripts.translation: 要開啟地下封印之門，必須用蘊含索爾之力的^0000FF火焰精華^000000淨化我。請從火炬上收集^0000FF10份火焰精華^000000。

scripts.text: One thing you must remember is... ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 can only be collected by the Inheritor of Faith.
scripts.translation: 請記住...只有信仰繼承者才能收集^0000FF火焰精華^000000。

scripts.text: I'll give the token of the Inheritor of Faith to the party leader. Only the party leader can collect the ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000.
scripts.translation: 我會把信仰繼承者的信物交給隊長。只有隊長能收集^0000FF火焰精華^000000。

scripts.text: At that time, it was impossible to get rid of Devil Baphomet by ourselves. After numerous heroes sacrificed their lives, we could barely seal him under this Abbey.
scripts.translation: 當時我們根本無法獨自消滅惡魔巴風特。許多英雄犧牲後，我們才勉強將它封印在這座修道院地下。

scripts.text: However, Baphomet never gave up. He continuously strengthened his power. And his power has brought new life to this shrine.
scripts.translation: 然而巴風特從未放棄，不斷增強自己的力量。這股力量也讓神殿中的魔物復甦。

scripts.text: Some of these monsters have magical powers. Baphomet calls them his 'Apostles'.
scripts.translation: 這些魔物中有些擁有魔力，巴風特稱它們為‘使徒’。

scripts.text: The apostles are cloning themselves to fill the shrine with their evil energy. They are the monsters here in this catacomb.
scripts.translation: 使徒會不斷複製自己，用邪惡能量充斥神殿。這裡的魔物就是它們。

scripts.text: Kill the Apostles. They can only be distinguished from their clones because they will possess a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000...
scripts.translation: 擊敗使徒。它們與分身唯一的區別是身上帶有^0000FF使徒之證^000000...

scripts.text: If each party member possesses a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000, Baphomet will not be able to perceive your entrance to the Main Altar underground.
scripts.translation: 如果每位隊員都持有^0000FF使徒之證^000000，巴風特就無法察覺你們進入了地下主祭壇。

scripts.text: If Baphomet perceives you when you pass through the sealed gate, he may release his tremendous magical power. Then, this abbey will be demolished.
scripts.translation: 如果你們通過封印之門時被巴風特察覺，它可能會釋放強大的魔力，將修道院夷為平地。

scripts.text: Kill the apostles and get the ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation: 擊敗使徒並取得^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: You look like the leader of this party. You need to go and get ^0000FF10 Essence of Fire^000000 from the torches.
scripts.translation: 你看起來是這支隊伍的隊長。去火炬那裡收集^0000FF10份火焰精華^000000。

scripts.text: Now I'll carve you the symbol which shows you're a inheritor of faith. Be aware that no one in your party but you can collect the Essence of Fire.
scripts.translation: 我現在要為你刻下信仰繼承者的標記。記住，隊伍中只有你能收集火焰精華。

scripts.text: You should also carry a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000, so find one for yourself too.
scripts.translation: 你自己也要帶上^0000FF使徒之證^000000，去找一枚吧。

scripts.text: When all of you are ready to go, let me know. I'll open the sealed gate when you're ready.
scripts.translation: 等大家都準備好了就告訴我，我會為你們開啟封印之門。

scripts.text: Make sure that your party leader has listened to my explanation of what you and your companions must do.
scripts.translation: 請確保隊長已經聽過我對你們和同伴任務的說明。

scripts.text: Kill the Apostles of Baphomet and find their ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation: 擊敗巴風特的使徒並找到它們的^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: It might be better to kill all of them because there is no way to differentiate them from their clones.
scripts.translation: 最好把它們全部擊敗，因為無法分辨使徒和它們的分身。

scripts.text: Make sure that you have listened to all that I have to say before saying that you are ready.
scripts.translation: 說準備好了之前，請確認你已經聽完我所有說明。

scripts.text: Are you ready to go? Then I'll open this sealed gate now.
scripts.translation: 準備出發了嗎？那我現在開啟封印之門。

scripts.text: It may be difficult but I wish you luck braving the perils of this catacomb.
scripts.translation: 前路或許艱難，祝你們能勇闖墓穴中的險境。

scripts.text: Remember, you need to collect ^0000FF10 Essence of Fire^000000 from the torches and the ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000 from the Apostles of Baphomet.
scripts.translation: 記住，你們必須從火炬收集^0000FF10份火焰精華^000000，另外從巴風特使徒身上取得^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: To remind you again, I must be substantialized within the next hour. So everyone, finish your work within that time!
scripts.translation: 再提醒一次，我的實體化只能維持一小時。大家要在這段時間內完成任務！

scripts.text: To remind you again, I can be substantialized for the next hour. So everyone, finish your work within that time.
scripts.translation: 再提醒一次，我能實體化的時間只有一小時。大家要在這段時間內完成任務。

scripts.text: Did you get 10 ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 and ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000?
scripts.translation: 你拿到10份^0000FF火焰精華^000000和^0000FF使徒之證^000000了嗎？

scripts.text: Okay. You've done your work. Now check your companions and tell me when everyone has finished their work.
scripts.translation: 好，你完成了自己的任務。去確認同伴的情況，等大家都完成後再告訴我。

scripts.text: Not ready yet? You should prepare 10 ^0000FFEssence of Fire^000000 and ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好嗎？你應該準備10份^0000FF火焰精華^000000和^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: Do you have a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000?
Okay. You've done your work. Tell your representative to check your companions and come to me when everyone has finished their work.
scripts.translation: 好，你已經完成任務。讓隊伍代表確認同伴的情況，等大家都完成後再來找我。

scripts.text: Not ready yet? You should prepare ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好嗎？你應該準備好^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: Are you ready? I opened the sealed gate. To pass the gate, you should carry a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation: 準備好了嗎？封印之門已經開啟。通過時必須攜帶^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: Now you can go to the main altar. It is located in the bottom right corner of this floor.
scripts.translation: 現在可以前往主祭壇了，它就在這一層的右下角。

scripts.text: Your real battle will begin... I'll follow you soon and find a way to help you.
scripts.translation: 真正的戰鬥即將開始...我很快會跟上，設法幫助你們。

scripts.text: Are you ready? I opened the sealed gate. To pass the gate, you should carry a ^0000FFToken of Apostle^000000.
scripts.translation: 準備好了嗎？封印之門已經開啟。通過時必須攜帶^0000FF使徒之證^000000。

scripts.text: I'll complete opening the sealed gate when your representative tells me that you're ready.
scripts.translation: 等你們的代表告訴我準備好了，我就會完成封印之門的開啟。

scripts.text: What are you doing? The entrance of the main altar is opened now, go and fight! The entrance is near the bottom right side of this floor.
scripts.translation: 你們在做什麼？主祭壇入口已經打開了，快去戰鬥！入口就在這一層右下方。

scripts.text: I have nothing to say to you...
Where is your Token of Apostle? I said you should carry the Token of Apostle to pass this gate.
scripts.translation: 你的使徒之證呢？我說過通過這道門必須攜帶使徒之證。

scripts.text: A small object is shining under a leaning grave.
scripts.translation: 一塊傾斜的墓碑下，有一個小物件在閃閃發光。

scripts.text: I think this is the pendant...
I can only feel gloom from this Gravestone.
scripts.translation: 這塊墓碑只透著陰森的氣息。

scripts.text: I can only feel gloom from this Gravestone.
scripts.translation: 這塊墓碑只透著陰森的氣息。

scripts.text: A huge torch appearing as if it can burn everything is bobbing up and down in front of me.
scripts.translation: 眼前的巨大火炬搖曳著，彷彿能焚盡一切。

scripts.text: The grand appearance and heat of the fire makes me step back... But I pluck up my courage and reach out to pick up the torch.
scripts.translation: 兇猛的火勢和灼熱的氣息讓你退了一步...但你還是鼓起勇氣，伸手去取火炬。

scripts.text: The symbol of inheritor shines. Then a small crystal falls into my hand from the torch.
scripts.translation: 繼承者的印記閃耀起來，一顆小水晶從火炬中落入你的手心。

scripts.text: You have 10 Essence of Fire already, so you don't need to collect any more.
scripts.translation: 你已經有 10 個雷神托爾的精魄，不用再收集了。

scripts.text: You don't need to collect Essence of Fire anymore.
scripts.translation: 你不需要再收集雷神托爾的精魄了。

scripts.text: A huge torch appearing as if it can burn everything is bobbing up and down in front of me..
scripts.translation: 眼前的巨大火炬搖曳著，彷彿能焚盡一切。

scripts.text: You are not a inheritor of faith. Do not desecrate the Essence of Fire with your disrespectful hands.
scripts.translation: 你不是信仰繼承者。不要用無禮之手褻瀆火焰精華。

scripts.text: Your SP has not recovered yet. You lost your SP on the altar, but it seems the power of the seal has returned.
scripts.translation: 你的 SP 尚未恢復。雖然在祭壇上耗盡了 SP，封印的力量似乎已經恢復。

scripts.text: I can feel the power of the altar came back by adding magical power.
scripts.translation: 注入魔力後，你感覺到祭壇的力量恢復了。

scripts.text: But you can't use your magic for 3 minutes because you used your SP on the altar.
scripts.translation: 你已將 SP 注入祭壇，接下來 3 分鐘內無法使用魔法。

scripts.text: An evil power, too terrible to describe, lies under the great altar radiating a violet color.
scripts.translation: 巨大的祭壇之下，潛伏著一股難以形容的邪惡力量，散發著紫色的光芒。

scripts.text: Complicated Magical Rune letters blink rapidly, attempting to suppress the dreadful power within.
scripts.translation: 複雜的魔法符文快速閃爍，試圖壓制其中可怕的力量。

scripts.text: The bottom of the Main Altar trembles furiously.
scripts.translation: 主祭壇的底部劇烈地顫抖著。

scripts.text: Watch out! Something... Something is coming.
scripts.translation: 小心！有什麼東西...有什麼東西來了。

scripts.text: An evil power, too terrible to describe, lies under the great altar radiating a violet color.
scripts.translation: 巨大的祭壇之下，潛伏著一股難以形容的邪惡力量，散發著紫色的光芒。

scripts.text: Complicated Magical Rune letters blink rapidly, attempting to suppress the dreadful power within.
scripts.translation: 複雜的魔法符文快速閃爍，試圖壓制其中可怕的力量。

scripts.text: Good job, my descendants... You've finished the long-cherished task that me and my bretheren could not complete.
scripts.translation: 做得好，我的後裔們...你們完成了我和同伴一直未能完成的夙願。
我由衷感謝你們的幫助。

scripts.text: Our souls can finally rest in peace...
scripts.translation: 我們的靈魂終於可以安息了...

scripts.text: The struggle for peace on this world will never end. But... my role here is finally over because there are brave heroes like you.
scripts.translation: 這個世界爭取和平的鬥爭永不會結束。但是...有你們這樣的勇者在，我在這裡的使命終於結束了。

scripts.text: Okay. I'll let you and your group leave here safely.
scripts.translation: 好，我會讓你和隊伍安全離開這裡。

scripts.text: If you leave, please say hello to Patrick for me.
scripts.translation: 離開後，請替我向帕特里克問好。

scripts.text: Do you still have something to do here? If you're done I'll let you leave safely...
scripts.translation: 你們還有事情要辦嗎？如果結束了，我就讓你們安全離開...
